How a school swarms

Why fish swarm, circle and swim together

Claim checked in source · Our model, code or measurement

BL = body length. p = heading alignment; m = group rotation. Both range from 0 to 1.

AFour collective states

100 simulated fish. These zone settings are our examples.

BThree zones, one blind spot

Repulsion
Turn away; highest priority.

Orientation
Match neighbouring headings.

Attraction
Move towards neighbours.

Blind spot: 90° behind.

S1: rr=1 BL, α=270°. Shown: Δro=5, Δra=6.

DFrom neighbours to movement

  1. See neighbours within α. sch-pair
  2. Inside rr? Repel first. sch-pair
  3. Else combine heading and attraction. sch-want
  4. No neighbour? Keep the heading. sch-want
  5. Turn ≤ θτ; move sτ. sch-turn
  6. Give the leader extra weight. weight
  7. Repel at walls; clamp position. sch-walls
  8. A dart startles nearby fish. sch-startle-all

S1: s=3 BL/s, θ=40°/s. Game: 2 BL/s, 120°/s; no model noise. A 90° turn travels 6.75 vs 1.50 BL.

FThe Forth implementation

Four complete school.fth words; comments omitted.

sch-pair168 B
: sch-pair ( j -- )
  dup MB_YOU sc!
  sch-stride * sch-base +
  dup read-mailbox MB_PERP sc@ - MB_U sc!
  dup 1 + read-mailbox MB_PERP 1 + sc@ - MB_U 1 + sc!
  2 + read-mailbox MB_PERP 2 + sc@ - MB_U 2 + sc!
  MB_U vlen2 dup 0.000001 >
  over MB_R2 sc@ < &
  if
    sch-sqrt dup MB_DIST sc!
    1 swap / MB_U vscale
    heading-dot-u MB_COSB par@ >=
    if
      r-rep inside if
        -1 MB_SUM_R acc+u
        MB_N_R count+
      else r-ori inside if
        you-weight MB_SUM_O acc+v
        MB_N_O count+
      else
        you-weight MB_SUM_A acc+u
        MB_N_A count+
      then then
    then
  else drop then ;
sch-want88 B
: sch-want
  MB_WANT vzero
  MB_N_R seen? if
    MB_SUM_R add-wanted
  else
    MB_N_O seen? if MB_SUM_O add-wanted then
    MB_N_A seen? if MB_SUM_A add-wanted then
  then
  MB_WANT vnorm 0.000001 > not if
    MB_WANT heading>sc
  then ;
sch-turn104 B
: sch-turn
  MB_VX me sch@ MB_WANT sc@ *
  MB_VY me sch@ MB_WANT 1 + sc@ * +
  MB_VZ me sch@ MB_WANT 2 + sc@ * +
  dup MB_COST par@ >= if drop else
    perp-all
    MB_PERP vnorm 0.000001 > not if
      perp-fallback
    then
    turn-all
    MB_WANT vnorm drop
  then ;
sch-follow131 B
: sch-follow
  dup MB_ME sc!
  clear-sums
  sch-scan-cache
  sch-n 0 do
    i over <> if i sch-pair then
  loop
  drop
  sch-walls sch-want
  sch-startle? if
    sch-startle-away
    sch-startle-tick
  then
  sch-turn
  MB_WANT sc@ MB_NVX me sch!
  MB_WANT 1 + sc@ MB_NVY me sch!
  MB_WANT 2 + sc@ MB_NVZ me sch!
  0 advance 1 advance 2 advance
  clamp-all ;
